_comment: W6+SH OBSERVABILITY PROBE at 50 stations, 20 epochs (docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network §11 item 1).
THE QUESTION.  The record says the W6+SH slice withholds every epoch at 50
stations (§9.7.2 finding 5, 240/240 withheld) and solves at 303 in the field
(_cbq305_2f_12h_d10).  But that 50-station attempt ran the loader's DEFAULT
ionosphere_weighting.elevation_cutoff_deg = 10 — its own posture line reported
'SH-VTEC / W6 slice: PARTIAL 2/3', and the missing member was the >= 25 deg
cutoff.  Since the 25 deg cutoff is the single validated SH lever (at 10 deg the
305-station field diverged a00 296 -> -305 TECU with a FLAT per-degree spectrum;
at 25 deg it holds 30.9 -> 29.4), the documented withhold has two candidate
causes and they differ by a factor of 6 in the cost of every future arm:
H1  station support — the slice needs O(100+) stations to separate the
satellite DCB from the field, so 50 can never work and the fixture must
be scaled to ~300 (§11's recommendation).
H2  the cutoff — 50 stations were always enough and the arm was measuring a
degenerate low-elevation-code field, in which case the ladder floor is
<= 50 and the graded arm is ~6x cheaper.
This probe is the discriminator.  20 epochs is enough: the failure mode is a
rank-gate withhold at epoch 1, not a convergence outcome — 'emitted 20/20' vs
'withheld 20/20' is decided in the first epoch and cannot be read as a level
claim (nothing here is graded).
DEGREE 4, not the template's 15.  Degree 15 at 50 stations is not a sanctioned
pairing (that rule needs >= 150 stations); the validated low-n lineage is
degree 4, and the earlier degree sweeps all degenerated at low n.  Degree 4 is
also the MOST FAVOURABLE case — 25 coefficients instead of 256 — so a withhold
here is a lower bound on the ladder floor for any higher degree.
CLOCK DATUM moved to S26000SIM (lat +1.09) — the generator fell back to
S01000SIM at lat -68.75, the roster's most polar station, and §9.8 measured ~8x
more common-level wander from a polar datum.  Irrelevant to a rank probe, set
here so the posture matches the arm this probe is scouting for.
Own product path + own CWD: it shares the G-A fixture's observations and must
not touch the G-A arm's products.txt.
